group_manifest.proof_strategy: For each witness, select the generated pure emp alternative. Unfold CircularAreaIsFullResult; for the three IsFull witnesses choose the directly forced result branch. For the two GetDataLength witnesses, destruct CircularAreaIsFullResult, use retval = 0 or retval <> 0 to eliminate the incompatible branch, unfold CircularAreaDataLengthResult, and select the remaining full/non-full branch. Finish structural conjunctions, reflexive result equalities, and 0/1 contradictions with standard propositional or lia-style arithmetic without forbidden lemmas.

group_entry.grouping_reason: All five obligations share the same pure result-predicate classification pattern and need no helper family or dependency ordering; keeping them together minimizes worker count and remains below max_witnesses_per_group = 12.

pure_plan.data_length_returns: Unfold CircularAreaIsFullResult, eliminate the branch incompatible with retval = 0 or retval <> 0, then unfold CircularAreaDataLengthResult and choose the forced non-full or full branch.
